38' Wesley (Real Sociedad) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

34' Real Sociedad enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

21' 1 - 1 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Thibaut Courtois into the roof of the net.
21' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is going to take the penalty!

21' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Francisco Maeso stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. PENALTY to Real Sociedad! Great chance to score.
20' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) gets a yellow card.
17' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

16' Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.

12' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
10' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Thibaut Courtois, who smothers the ball.
10' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 51:49.
9' Good movement by Wesley (Real Sociedad), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
8' Real Sociedad are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
6' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.

5' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Trent Alexander-Arnold. The score is now 1:0.

4' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.

2' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
